title: an installed skill that was edited by hand gets a warning that names it
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). After `install skill --scope project --yes` and an edit of `.agents/skills/jitso/SKILL.md`, doctor prints a `warn skill-project:` line that says `edited by hand` and names the file, and exits 0. The oracle has no `doctor` command: it answers `unknown command "doctor"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every pinned line FAILS on it.
